body:
## Story Points: 5 | Priority: P0 | Sprint: 2

## Summary
Manage parking slots (staff CRUD) and expose public real-time slot availability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] GET /api/v1/parking/slots is public (no auth required)
- [ ] GET /api/v1/parking/slots/available returns AVAILABLE slots only
- [ ] POST /api/v1/parking/slots restricted to ADMINISTRATOR and PARKING_ATTENDANT
- [ ] PUT /api/v1/parking/slots/{id} updates type, floor, status (staff only)
- [ ] DELETE /api/v1/parking/slots/{id} marks slot OUT_OF_SERVICE (staff only)
- [ ] Slot types: REGULAR, DISABLED, EV
- [ ] Slot statuses: AVAILABLE, OCCUPIED, RESERVED, OUT_OF_SERVICE
- [ ] Duplicate slot number returns 400
- [ ] Seed: 20 slots in schema.sql

## Tests
ParkingControllerTest covers public slots + entry/exit flows

## Definition of Done
Slot CRUD works for staff; public availability endpoint accessible without JWT; 20 seed slots present.
